_: The regulation profile (reg-md-plan.md 0.1, gap G1). ONE source of truth for the regulation the site is built for. The daily data job reads it through formats.mjs (SITE_REG, REG_END, regProfile) and switches by date when today (UTC) >= the next regulation's 'since'. A regulation's 'end' stays here for good: events dated after it count for the next one. Source ids set to null mean the source has no page for that regulation yet: the job then says 'not available yet' instead of reading another regulation's numbers.
